description: Power-conversion mappings with selected published screening priors and explicit project overrides.

exergy-imperative-component-methods.title: The Exergy Imperative component accounting methods
exergy-imperative-component-methods.applicable_boundary: Single-input power conversion at explicitly declared equipment terminals
exergy-imperative-component-methods.note: Mechanical kinetic and potential work are exergy. Performance priors, where present, cite their own sources.

doe-chp-gas-turbines.title: U.S. DOE Better Buildings: CHP Technologies—Gas Turbines
doe-chp-gas-turbines.license: U.S. Government work; verify report-specific third-party notices
doe-chp-gas-turbines.applicable_boundary: Natural-gas HHV input to net electricity for the 2 MW through 25 MW gas-turbine cases in Table 2
doe-chp-gas-turbines.note: Table values characterize full-load technology cases and are not a site heat-rate guarantee.

doe-pv-module-benchmarks-2024.title: DOE Solar Photovoltaic System Cost Benchmarks and PV Cells 101
doe-pv-module-benchmarks-2024.license: U.S. Government work; verify page-specific third-party notices
doe-pv-module-benchmarks-2024.applicable_boundary: Incident array-plane solar radiation to DC electricity at representative commercial crystalline-silicon module terminals
doe-pv-module-benchmarks-2024.note: The 2024 representative residential module is 400 W over 1.9 m2 (21.1%); DOE PV Cells 101 reports about 18%-22% for commercial panels. AC conversion is excluded.

doe-wind-conversion-eis.title: U.S. DOE Wellton-Mohawk Generating Facility Draft Environmental Impact Statement
doe-wind-conversion-eis.license: U.S. Government work; verify document-specific third-party notices
doe-wind-conversion-eis.applicable_boundary: Free-stream wind kinetic energy through the rotor swept area to turbine electrical output
doe-wind-conversion-eis.note: The source states a 35%-40% range for then-state-of-the-art turbines; it is an older generic screening envelope, not a modern turbine power curve or capacity factor.

nrel-hydropower-generator-range.title: NREL IEA Wind Task 24 Final Report, Volume 1
nrel-hydropower-generator-range.license: U.S. Government-sponsored public technical report; verify report notices
nrel-hydropower-generator-range.applicable_boundary: Hydraulic energy across common Pelton, Francis, and Kaplan hydropower conversion equipment to generator output
nrel-hydropower-generator-range.note: The report states that the three common turbine-generator types can achieve 80%-90%; head, flow, part load, and equipment condition remain site variables.

doe-transformer-standard-2024.title: DOE Energy Conservation Standards for Distribution Transformers Final Rule
doe-transformer-standard-2024.license: U.S. Government work; Federal Register rule and supporting tables
doe-transformer-standard-2024.applicable_boundary: Transformer input terminals to output terminals at the loading and test conditions used for DOE distribution-transformer efficiency standards
doe-transformer-standard-2024.note: Efficiency depends on phase, kVA, voltage class, insulation, and loading; conditional variants summarize Table I.3 rather than replacing a nameplate value.

nrel-inverter-benchmark-2021.title: NREL U.S. Solar Photovoltaic System and Energy Storage Cost Benchmark: Q1 2020
nrel-inverter-benchmark-2021.applicable_boundary: DC electricity at inverter input to AC electricity at inverter output under the benchmarked conversion conditions
nrel-inverter-benchmark-2021.note: Published benchmark sequence spans 94.0%-98.0%; recent modeled inverters reach 98%. Load and voltage dependence are not captured by a scalar prior.
